node.title: Nivel y frontera del resultado
node.summary: Locate a performance claim at task, team, organisation, network or programme level.

relations: Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.
No se atribuye éxito o fracaso macro a una intervención local ni se verifica aquí una cifra pública de auditorías.
The activation study should be assembled before outcomes are known, retaining failed reorganizations and absolute capability benchmarks rather than selecting only impressive survivors.
Es adaptación del diseño de estudio; el protocolo de atribución no establece por sí solo el benchmark de activación.
The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.
La relación conceptual no verifica cumplimiento de derechos en un caso concreto ni otorga representación sobre comunidades.
The case-study framework can preserve the field observation as evidence while recording the migration interpretation as a separate, testable layer with its own data requirements.
La codificación no equivale a validación independiente ni a adopción de una contribución por un organismo de estándares.
The historical Chicontepec account helps separate local capability formation from programme-level and territorial outcomes; improvement at one level cannot stand in for the others.
La crónica se refiere a 2013. No se trasladan sus cifras, juicios o condiciones regulatorias al estado actual.
